commands.title: System information
commands.description: Show model, serial number, software version, uptime, hostname, and management details.

commands.title: Management-plane resources
commands.description: Inspect management-plane CPU, memory, load, and processes.

commands.title: Disk and inode usage
commands.description: Show disk partition and inode utilization to identify capacity pressure.

commands.title: Software process status
commands.description: List PAN-OS software processes and current running states.

commands.title: Recent jobs
commands.description: Show commit, content, software, and operational job progress and failures.

commands.title: Configured administrators
commands.description: List administrator accounts visible to the firewall; output can expose account names.

commands.title: System clock
commands.description: Display firewall date and time for log and incident correlation.

commands.title: All interface state
commands.description: Show configured interfaces, link state, addressing, zones, and counters.

commands.title: ARP table
commands.description: Display IPv4 neighbor resolution entries across interfaces.

commands.title: Routing table
commands.description: Display installed routes, next hops, metrics, and route sources.

commands.title: BGP peer summary
commands.description: Summarize BGP peer state and received route counts.

commands.title: Session utilization
commands.description: Show current and maximum session counts, packet rate, and session setup rate.

commands.title: Sessions by source
commands.description: Filter active sessions by a source IPv4 or IPv6 address.

commands.title: Global drop counters
commands.command: show counter global filter severity drop delta yes
commands.description: Show the delta of global counters classified as packet drops.

commands.title: High-availability state
commands.description: Show local and peer HA roles, synchronization, and link states.

commands.title: IKE security associations
commands.description: Show current Internet Key Exchange security associations.

commands.title: IPsec security associations
commands.description: Show IPsec tunnel security associations, algorithms, and counters.

commands.title: Recent system logs
commands.command: show log system direction equal backward count ${count}
commands.description: Read a bounded number of newest system log records; output can contain infrastructure details.

commands.title: Running configuration
commands.description: Display active configuration, which can contain addresses, usernames, and encrypted secrets.

commands.title: Restart firewall
commands.description: Restart the firewall and disrupt all traffic and management sessions.
